title.rendered: Archer Glen Book Fair During Fall Conferences

content.rendered:
The Archer Glen Library will be holding it’s Fall Book Fair during the week of conferences from October 22nd through October 26th. 

This is a great opportunity to purchase books and other items to enhance reading at home and gifts for the holidays while supporting our school library. Families can, also, purchase books for teacher’s classrooms to help them build their classroom libraries. The money raised during the AG Book Fair goes to enhancing our book collection in our library and replacing older worn out books. 
The Fall Book Fair times are as follows:
Monday, Oct. 22nd  – Wednesday, Oct. 24th – 7:45 – 8:00 am & 2:15 – 3:30 pm (Students accompanied by an adult can visit at 7:30 am)
Thursday, Oct. 25th – 7:30 am – 3:30 pm & 6:00 – 8:00 pm
Friday, Oct. 26th – 7:30 am – 10:30 am
